sourceTitle: The Lights of the Church and the Light of Science Essay #6 from "Science and Hebrew Tradition"
description: "The Lights of the Church and the Light of Science" by Thomas Henry Huxley is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century, likely during the Victorian era. This work engages with the intersection of religious narratives and scientific inquiry, addressing the historical validity of biblical texts, particularly the accounts found in the Old Testament, and their compatibility with modern scientific understanding.
